forklift.sd_prompt: photo of a yellow forklift carrying a wooden pallet of cardboard boxes across a large modern warehouse, tall blue shelving racks, polished concrete floor, bright overhead lights, realistic photograph, wide shot

subjects.description: A yellow forklift with a driver, carrying a wooden pallet stacked with cardboard boxes
subjects.action: Drives across the warehouse floor from left to right, turns slightly and continues towards the shelves

subjects.description: Tall blue shelving racks filled with boxes

cinematography.camera_motion: Static camera on a tripod at eye level
cinematography.framing: Wide shot of the warehouse floor and the forklift

actions.description: The forklift drives forward across the warehouse floor carrying the pallet
The forklift turns towards the shelving racks and keeps driving, the pallet swaying slightly on the forks

caption.temporal_caption: A yellow forklift carries a pallet of boxes across a bright warehouse floor and turns towards the tall shelving racks.

aisle_robot.sd_prompt: view from a low mobile robot driving through a narrow warehouse aisle, tall shelves with boxes on both sides, pallets and boxes standing on the floor close by, polished concrete floor, realistic photograph

subjects.description: A narrow warehouse aisle between tall shelves stacked with cardboard boxes, with pallets standing on the floor
subjects.action: The shelves, boxes and pallets rush past both sides of the frame as the robot drives forward quickly

cinematography.camera_motion: The video is captured from a camera mounted on an autonomous mobile robot driving forward quickly along the aisle; continuous forward tracking shot
cinematography.framing: Low forward-facing view with the end of the aisle in the center

actions.description: The robot drives quickly forward; pallets and shelves sweep past the left and right edges of the frame and the end of the aisle comes closer

caption.temporal_caption: Forward-facing camera footage from a mobile robot driving quickly through a warehouse aisle; pallets and shelves sweep past on both sides.

picking_arm.sd_prompt: photo of a large orange industrial robotic arm with a gripper, mounted next to a conveyor belt, holding a cardboard box in the air, warehouse in the background, realistic photograph, wide shot

subjects.description: An orange six-axis industrial robot arm with a suction gripper
subjects.action: Picks a cardboard box from the conveyor, swings it over and places it on the stacked pallet, then returns to the conveyor

subjects.description: Cardboard boxes on a moving conveyor belt
subjects.action: Move along the belt towards the robot

cinematography.framing: Medium shot of the robot arm, the conveyor and the pallet

actions.description: The robot arm lowers its suction gripper onto a box on the conveyor and lifts it
The arm swings the box over to the pallet, sets it down on the stack and swings back while the next box arrives on the conveyor

caption.temporal_caption: An orange industrial robot arm picks a cardboard box from a conveyor belt and stacks it on a pallet while the next box arrives.

conveyor.sd_prompt: photo of many cardboard parcels on a long conveyor belt in a parcel sorting warehouse, rollers and metal frames, bright lights, realistic photograph

subjects.description: Cardboard parcels of different sizes on a long conveyor belt
subjects.action: Travel steadily along the belt from the back towards the front of the frame and leave the frame

subjects.description: A parcel sorting line with rollers and metal frames

cinematography.framing: Medium-wide shot along the conveyor belt

actions.description: Parcels move steadily along the conveyor towards the camera; new parcels keep arriving from the back

caption.temporal_caption: Cardboard parcels travel steadily along a conveyor belt in a sorting warehouse, new parcels arriving from the back.
